subtopics.label: Stroke and Cerebrovascular Disease
subtopics.description: Research on ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke including mechanisms, risk factors, diagnosis, treatment (thrombolysis, thrombectomy, anticoagulation), outcomes, disparities, and secondary prevention. Covers atrial fibrillation, cervical artery dissection, subarachnoid hemorrhage, cerebral amyloid angiopathy, and cerebrovascular imaging biomarkers.
subtopics.short_description: Mechanisms, treatment, outcomes, and prevention of ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke and cerebrovascular conditions.

subtopics.label: Epilepsy and Seizure Disorders
subtopics.description: Research on epilepsy diagnosis, seizure mechanisms, treatment (antiseizure medications, vagal nerve stimulation, surgery), EEG monitoring, infantile spasms, status epilepticus, and epilepsy care systems. Includes pediatric epilepsy, rare epilepsies, glucose transporter deficiency, and seizure detection technologies.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis, mechanisms, and treatment of epilepsy and seizures across pediatric and adult populations.

subtopics.label: Brain Injury and Neurorehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on traumatic brain injury (TBI), acquired brain injury, disorders of consciousness, and neurorehabilitation including cognitive recovery, functional outcomes, assistive technology, and neuromodulation for recovery. Covers pediatric TBI, cognitive-motor dissociation, deep brain stimulation for TBI, and rehabilitation interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Recovery, functional outcomes, and rehabilitation interventions for traumatic and acquired brain injury.

subtopics.label: Neuroimaging Methods and Brain MRI
subtopics.description: Research on advanced neuroimaging techniques including quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM), oxygen extraction fraction mapping, arterial spin labeling, fMRI methods, diffusion imaging, and brain PET. Covers technical development, validation, and clinical application of MRI-based biomarkers for neurological and psychiatric conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Technical development and clinical application of quantitative MRI and PET-based neurological biomarkers.

subtopics.label: Corneal Confocal Microscopy and Peripheral Neuropathy
subtopics.description: Research using corneal confocal microscopy (CCM) as a non-invasive biomarker for peripheral neuropathy, neurodegeneration, and systemic diseases including diabetic neuropathy, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's disease, and stroke. Covers corneal nerve fiber loss quantification, Langerhans cells, and CCM as a surrogate marker for central and peripheral nervous system pathology.
subtopics.short_description: Non-invasive corneal nerve imaging as a biomarker for peripheral neuropathy and neurodegeneration.

subtopics.label: Multiple Sclerosis: Imaging, Biomarkers, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on multiple sclerosis including MRI-based lesion characterization (paramagnetic rim lesions, QSM), functional and structural connectivity, corneal nerve biomarkers, disease-modifying therapies (natalizumab), and clinical outcomes. Covers demyelination mechanisms, white matter pathology, and treatment effectiveness across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: MRI biomarkers, disease-modifying therapies, and clinical outcomes in multiple sclerosis.

subtopics.label: Synaptic Biology and Ion Channel Physiology
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms of synaptic transmission, vesicle release, and ion channel function including SNARE proteins, Munc13/Munc18, complexin, alpha-synuclein, metabotropic glutamate receptors, potassium channels (BK, K2P, HCN), sodium channels, and glutamate transporters. Covers structural biology, electrophysiology, and pharmacology of synaptic and membrane proteins.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of synaptic transmission, vesicle release, and ion channel function in neurons.

subtopics.label: Neuroinflammation, Microglia, and Neuroimmunology
subtopics.description: Research on neuroinflammation mechanisms including microglial function, tau-driven neuroinflammation, blood-brain barrier dysfunction, neuroimmune interactions, and inflammatory pathways in neurological diseases. Covers microglial NF-κB signaling, cGAS-IFN pathways, CD36, border-associated macrophages, and immune cell trafficking in stroke and neurodegeneration.
subtopics.short_description: Microglial function, neuroimmune signaling, and inflammatory pathways in neurological disease.

subtopics.label: Headache Disorders and Pain Neuroscience
subtopics.description: Research on headache disorders including migraine, occipital neuralgia, nerve compression headaches, and surgical treatment (nerve decompression). Covers CGRP-targeted therapies, onabotulinumtoxinA, headache surgery outcomes, trigger-site deactivation, and neuropathic pain mechanisms and treatment.
subtopics.short_description: Migraine, neuropathic pain mechanisms, CGRP-targeted therapies, and surgical headache treatment.

subtopics.label: Neural Circuits, Cognition, and Memory
subtopics.description: Research on neural circuit mechanisms underlying cognition, memory, learning, and behavior including hippocampal function, prefrontal cortex circuits, synaptic plasticity, and neuromodulation. Covers mnemonic prediction errors, fear learning, social behavior circuits, reward pathways, and the neural basis of cognitive processes.
subtopics.short_description: Circuit mechanisms underlying memory, learning, fear, and reward in hippocampal and prefrontal systems.

subtopics.label: Neurodevelopment, Neurogenetics, and Single-Cell Genomics
subtopics.description: Research on brain development, neurogenetics, and single-cell genomic approaches including RNA splicing, isoform analysis, epigenomics, and transcriptomics in brain cell types. Covers neural stem cells, cortical development, interneuron differentiation, and genetic/epigenetic regulation of brain function and disease.
subtopics.short_description: Genetic and epigenetic regulation of brain development using single-cell transcriptomic and genomic approaches.

subtopics.label: Neurovascular Unit and Blood-Brain Barrier
subtopics.description: Research on blood-brain barrier structure and function, neurovascular coupling, glymphatic system, and cerebrovascular biology. Covers BBB permeability measurement, focused ultrasound BBB opening, pericyte biology, endothelial dysfunction, and neurovascular mechanisms in Alzheimer's disease, stroke, and other neurological conditions.
subtopics.short_description: BBB permeability, glymphatic function, and neurovascular coupling in stroke and neurological disease.

subtopics.label: Movement Disorders and Neuromodulation
subtopics.description: Research on Parkinson's disease, movement disorders, and neuromodulation including deep brain stimulation (DBS), spinal cord stimulation, transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS), and focused ultrasound. Covers DBS programming, patient attitudes toward DBS, motor circuit mechanisms, and wearable technology for movement disorder monitoring.
subtopics.short_description: Deep brain stimulation, focused ultrasound, and motor circuit mechanisms in Parkinson's and movement disorders.

subtopics.label: Alzheimer's Disease Biomarkers and Neuroimaging
subtopics.description: Research on Alzheimer's disease biomarkers including amyloid-beta, tau PET, CSF markers, glymphatic clearance, and neuroimaging measures of disease progression. Covers tau-amyloid interactions, blood-brain barrier dysfunction in AD, sleep and tau deposition, choroid plexus, and multimodal imaging approaches for early detection and staging.
subtopics.short_description: Amyloid, tau PET, CSF markers, and multimodal imaging for early detection and staging of Alzheimer's disease.

subtopics.label: Spinal Cord Injury and Spine Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on traumatic spinal cord injury, degenerative spine disease, and spine surgery outcomes including cervical myelopathy, lumbar disc disease, and spinal cord tumors. Covers surgical techniques, neurological outcomes, global health perspectives on spinal trauma, and complications of spine surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical outcomes, neurological recovery, and global health perspectives on spinal cord injury and spine disease.

subtopics.label: Late-Life Depression, Mood Disorders, and Psychiatric Neuroscience
subtopics.description: Research on the neurobiology, neuroimaging correlates, and treatment of late-life depression, bipolar disorder, PTSD, and related mood disorders, including psychotherapy outcomes and brain circuit dysfunction.
subtopics.short_description: Neurobiology, neuroimaging, and treatment of late-life depression, bipolar disorder, and PTSD.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Neurological Complications and Long COVID
subtopics.description: Studies examining neurological manifestations of COVID-19 infection, including brain imaging findings, cognitive sequelae, long COVID symptoms, post-acute sequelae (PASC), and rehabilitation of neuropsychiatric complications.
subtopics.short_description: Brain imaging findings, cognitive sequelae, and rehabilitation of long COVID neuropsychiatric complications.

subtopics.label: Skull Base Surgery and Cranial Approaches
subtopics.description: Research on surgical approaches to the skull base, cavernous sinus, craniovertebral junction, and parasellar regions, including endoscopic, transpetrosal, frontotemporal, and far lateral techniques.
subtopics.short_description: Endoscopic and open surgical approaches to the skull base, cavernous sinus, and craniovertebral junction.

subtopics.label: Meningioma: PET/MRI Imaging and Treatment
subtopics.description: Studies using DOTATATE PET/MRI for meningioma diagnosis, grading, radiosurgery planning, and response assessment, as well as novel medical therapies for meningiomas.
subtopics.short_description: DOTATATE PET/MRI for meningioma diagnosis, radiosurgery planning, and novel medical therapies.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Brain Tumors and CNS Gliomas
subtopics.description: Research on pediatric brain tumors including DIPG, high-grade gliomas, ATRT, and leptomeningeal disease, encompassing convection-enhanced delivery, intraarterial drug delivery, and molecular classification.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular classification and drug delivery strategies for DIPG, high-grade gliomas, and pediatric CNS tumors.

subtopics.label: CNS Gene Therapy and AAV Vector Delivery
subtopics.description: Studies on adeno-associated virus (AAV)-mediated gene therapy for neurological diseases including CLN2 Batten disease, metachromatic leukodystrophy, and SMA, including biodistribution, safety, and efficacy outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: AAV-mediated gene therapy for Batten disease, leukodystrophy, and other inherited neurological conditions.

subtopics.label: Delirium in Pediatric and Critical Care Settings
subtopics.description: Research on the prevalence, risk factors, biomarkers, and outcomes of delirium in pediatric ICU, NICU, and hematopoietic cell transplant settings, including pharmacological prevention strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, biomarkers, and pharmacological prevention of delirium in pediatric ICU and transplant settings.

subtopics.label: Stroke Diagnosis, Misdiagnosis, and Quality of Care
subtopics.description: Studies examining diagnostic accuracy, misdiagnosis rates, quality metrics, and healthcare disparities in acute ischemic stroke and TIA management in emergency and inpatient settings.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnostic accuracy, misdiagnosis rates, and healthcare disparities in acute stroke and TIA management.

subtopics.label: Ischemic Stroke Mechanisms, Imaging, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on the pathophysiology, neuroimaging biomarkers (OEF, QSM, retinal vessels), cardioembolic sources, and clinical outcomes of ischemic stroke and cerebrovascular events.
subtopics.short_description: Pathophysiology, neuroimaging biomarkers, and clinical outcomes of ischemic stroke and cerebrovascular events.

subtopics.label: Dysphagia, Voice Disorders, and Swallowing Neuroscience
subtopics.description: Studies on swallowing dysfunction, aspiration, post-swallow residue, respiratory-swallow coordination, and laryngeal motor neuropathy in neurological conditions including Parkinson's disease.
subtopics.short_description: Swallowing dysfunction, aspiration, and laryngeal motor neuropathy in Parkinson's and neurological conditions.

subtopics.label: Breast Reconstruction Sensory Reinnervation
subtopics.description: Research on targeted nipple-areola complex reinnervation and sensory recovery following mastectomy and breast reconstruction, including gender-affirming surgery and comparison of reconstructive techniques.
subtopics.short_description: Targeted nipple-areola reinnervation and sensory recovery following mastectomy and reconstructive surgery.

subtopics.label: HIV-Associated Neurocognitive Disorders
subtopics.description: Studies on cognitive impairment, brain abnormalities, biomarkers, and neuropathology in people living with HIV, including CSF compartmentalization, galectin-9, and cellular rejuvenation strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Cognitive impairment, brain biomarkers, and neuropathology in people living with HIV.

subtopics.label: Neuroimmunology and Innate Lymphoid Cell Biology
subtopics.description: Research on innate lymphoid cells (ILCs), neuropeptide regulation of mucosal immunity, gut-brain immune interactions, and the role of ILC3s in neuroinflammation and tissue protection.
subtopics.short_description: Neuropeptide regulation of ILCs, mucosal immunity, and gut-brain immune interactions in neuroinflammation.

subtopics.label: Neurosteroids, Reproductive Hormones, and Mood
subtopics.description: Studies on allopregnanolone, progesterone metabolites, and neuroactive steroids in perinatal anxiety, postpartum depression, and reproductive mood disorders, including estrogen receptor biology.
subtopics.short_description: Allopregnanolone and neuroactive steroids in perinatal anxiety, postpartum depression, and reproductive mood disorders.

subtopics.label: Neurosurgical Education, Simulation, and Assistive Technology
subtopics.description: Research on surgical training methods including augmented reality, virtual reality, 3D neuroanatomy courses, and assistive technology access for patients with brain injury and cognitive impairment.
subtopics.short_description: Augmented reality, virtual reality, and 3D simulation tools for surgical training and patient assistive technology.
